body: Contracts are frozen. Track A starts on the event log.

task.title: Append-only event log
task.brief: Implement EventLog with monotonic seq assignment, LF-only line endings, and truncation recovery on a torn final line.
acceptance: seq starts at 1 and increases by 1 per append
written bytes contain no carriage return on any platform
reopening an existing log resumes seq
a torn final line is truncated to the last valid seq

ack.restatement: Build an append-only JSONL log that stamps seq at append time, writes binary LF, and on open recovers by truncating at the first unparseable line.
ambiguities: Whether a torn line should be skipped or truncate the file — I read the brief as truncate, since skipping leaves a hole in seq.

findings.assertion: seq was read from the last line rather than tracked, which breaks on a torn tail
the append wrote a utf8 string rather than a Buffer, so a platform could translate the newline

body: Pushed at 4f68999. Self-critique found two: seq was read from the last line rather than tracked, which breaks on a torn tail; and the write used utf8 rather than a Buffer. Both closed.

reason: All four acceptance criteria evidenced at 4f68999; torn-tail case reproduced independently.
